text: DSH Agent Notes 是面向 Web 客户端的决策笔记插件。它向 DSH 注册 Agent Notes 技能、/agent-notes 命令、门禁工具和会话级提示规范。用户可查看笔记树状态，设置全局或单会话开关，重置会话覆盖，在仓库创建笔记目录骨架，并运行目录、格式和归档校验。技能提供写作方法与模板，项目技能副本可先预览再同步。适合希望保存代码决策理由并校验笔记规范的开发者。需要 Node.js 22.19 或更高版本，不需要 API 密钥。

DSH Agent Notes adds a skill, command, tools, and session policy for repository decision notes. Users can toggle rules, scaffold a notes tree, inspect status, and run tree, format, or archive checks. The bundled skill provides methods and templates. Requires Node.js 22.19+; no API key.
想让 AI 记住这次代码改动为什么这样设计。
有没有办法把被放弃的方案也记录在代码仓库里？
让 DSH 在每个会话里按需加载决策笔记规范。
我想给仓库的决策记录建个固定目录和模板。
How can I preserve the reasoning behind code changes in my repository?
I need an agent skill that helps maintain and validate decision notes.
「决策笔记技能」：DSH Agent Notes 通过 skills provider 暴露内置方法与模板，读取正文并剥除 frontmatter，供 agent 按需加载。
「开关和状态命令」：/agent-notes 可查看状态、切换全局或会话开关、重置覆盖、初始化笔记树及预览技能同步。
「笔记校验」：门禁工具运行目录、格式和归档检查并返回退出码；状态工具显示开关及笔记树概况。
插件从 data.jsdelivr.com 获取技能文件清单，并从 fastly.jsdelivr.net 拉取内容更新本地副本；未发现传输会话内容或 API 密钥要求。

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 或从 GitHub：> **注意：`plugin add` 只写依赖，不会把插件加进启用列表。** 实测确认：它把
> 包名写进 `profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dependencies`，但
> `dsh.profile.bundles` 里没有这一项 —— 而 DSH 是按 `bundles` **逐层加载**jsonc
> // $DSH_HOME/profiles/<你的profile>/package.json
> "dsh": {
>   "profile": {
>     "bundles": [
>       "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
>       "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
>       "dsh-agent-notes"        // ← 加这一行
>     ]
>   }
> }
> ```
>
> 然后**重启 DSH**。验证是否真加载：`dsh --profile <你的profile> --dump-config`
> 里应出现 `# == dsh-agent-notes` 与 `- id: agent-notes`。若只在依赖里而不在
> `bundles` 里，启动日志不会有报错，插件却完全没跑 —— 这是最容易踩空的一步。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 用起来：```
/agent-notes                 查看开关与笔记树状态
/agent-notes on              开启本会话的决策笔记（持久化，重载后保持）
/agent-notes on --global     改全局默认（影响所有未单独覆盖的会话）
/agent-notes reset           清除本会话覆盖，回到全局默认

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 默认是关闭的：装好插件后，**新会话和旧会话默认都不启用**，需要时手动打开（点胶囊，或
`/agent-notes on`）。这样装上插件不会悄悄改变任何既有会话的行为。

想让所有会话默认开启，二选一：

```
/agent-notes on --global        # 运行时改全局默认，落盘持久化
```

或在插件配置里写 `enabled: true`（仅在该配置生效的 profile 里）。

会话级开关优先级高于全局：单独关掉某个会话后，改全局也不会影响它。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 界面上的状态提示：不用敲命令也能一眼看到当前会话是否生效：**输入框工具行左侧**有一枚绿色胶囊
「● 笔记规范」，就挨着「完全权限/工作区内修改」那一排，**点击即切换**；
关闭时胶囊变灰。

它读的是**会话投影**（`agentNotes`），所以刷新、重连、切换会话都自动正确。
点击开关走的是官方斜杠命令通道（`/agent-notes on|off`），因此和手敲命令
**完全等价**，并且开关操作零 token。

> 设计说明：投影只折叠宿主自己写的 `command/run` 事件，本插件**不写会话日志**。
> 原因是插件零 `@deepseek-ai` 依赖，拿不到 `appendPluginRecord`；而退路
> `session.append('plugin:…')` 实测会写出 `ignorable=undefined` 的残废记录
> （`pluginRecordOf` 读不回），看着成功实则污染日志。走命令事件则完全绕开这个坑。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 笔记看板：对话区多一个「笔记」tab：对话 / 轨迹 旁边会多出一个 **「笔记」** tab，里面就是上游那套成品看板
（架构基线 / 演进时间线 / 避坑智库 / 决策清单四个视图），**不自绘 UI**：

> tab 里用 iframe 加载 vendored 的上游资产
> `skills/agent-notes/assets/agent-notes-board.html`，宿主只负责把**当前会话仓库**的
> 笔记实时注入它预留的 `window.__INLINE_DATA__` 插槽。
>
> 理由：官方看板是 76K 成熟 UI（交叉引用入度、因果链路、多维筛选），自绘只会
> 更丑、越走越远。iframe 让视觉与交互跟随上游更新，本插件只维护数据适配层
> （`lib/board.js` 的 `buildInlineData`）与一处正文渲染补丁：上游 `parseMarkdown`
> 不认 GFM 表格，`lib/board-markdown.js` 只补这一条，其余沿用上游输出。

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 笔记看板：对话区多一个「笔记」tab：它读的是**实时磁盘内容**而不是静态快照：宿主注册只读 HTTP 路由
（`/agent-notes/ui`、`/agent-notes/board`、`/agent-notes/note`、`/agent-notes/health`），
每次切到该 tab 现读。

> 不用会话投影的原因：投影的 `view` 必须是**同步纯函数**，读不到文件系统
> （已核对源码 `view: state => wire.view(state)`）。
>
> 安全边界：路由只接受固定路径，只读 `notesRoot` 之下且拒绝任何 `..`；
> 会话解析不出笔记根时返回 **409**，绝不猜一个路径或退回进程目录。

**注入数据必须防住两件事**（都有回归测试）：

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 笔记看板：对话区多一个「笔记」tab：1. 笔记正文里出现 `</script>`、`<!--` 这类片段时，会把注入的脚本块从中间截断
   —— 表现为页面空白、计数恒为 0。做法是把 JSON 里每个 `<` 转成 `<`。
2. 用字符串形式调 `String.replace` 时，数据里的 `$&`、`` $` `` 会被当成反向引用
   展开，凭空塞进原 HTML 片段。必须用**函数式** replace。

开启后，模型侧还会自动获得：
- **`agent-notes` 技能** —— 完整方法论、六类判定、模板、归档规矩，按需加载；
- **`agent_notes_gate` 工具** —— 真跑校验脚本并返回**进程退出码**，不是「看起来合规」；
- **`agent_notes_status` 工具** —— 当前开关与笔记树概况；
- **会话级规范段** —— 只在开关打开的会话注入，不污染全局系统提示词。
section: 笔记看板：对话区多一个「笔记」tab

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 工具作用于哪个仓库：`agent_notes_gate` / `agent_notes_status` 默认作用于**当前会话的仓库根**
（取自会话头的 `cwd`，向上找含 `.git` 的目录）。也可以显式传 `cwd` 覆盖。

**会话拿不到工作目录时会明确失败**，返回 `passed: false` + `reason: "NO_SESSION_CWD"`，
而不是退回进程当前目录。这一点是刻意的：DSH 进程的 cwd 是**它自己的安装目录**，
那里往往也有 `.agents/notes`（DSH 自己的开发笔记），退回过去会真的跑通并返回
绿 —— 但测的根本不是你的仓库，属于「假绿」。宁可报错。

> 所以：如果你的会话是在没有工作区的状态下建的，跑门禁请显式传 `cwd`。

section: 目标仓库不必是 Node 项目

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 零篇笔记不算通过：门禁只有在**至少验过一篇笔记**时才可能返回绿：

| 情况 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `.agents/notes` 不存在 | `passed: false`，`reason: NO_NOTES_TREE` |
| 目录存在但一篇笔记都没有 | `passed: false`，`reason: NO_NOTES_YET` |
| 有笔记且全部合规 | `passed: true`，`noteCount` 为实际篇数 |
| 有笔记但有违规 | `passed: false`，`exitCode: 1` + 具体诊断 |

底层的三个脚本在空目录上都 `exit 0` —— **没东西可验不等于验过了**。插件在调用脚本前
先拦一道，返回值里始终带 `noteCount`，让你能分辨这两种情况。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 笔记长什么样：路径即状态，无总索引：

```
.agents/notes/{lifecycle}/{class}/yyyy-mm-dd-主题.md
```

| lifecycle | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `proposed/` | 未落地的方案稿 |
| `implemented/` | 已落地，随代码同步事实 |
| `rejected/` | 审慎否掉，仅当能防重犯时保留 |
| `archived/` | 已封存，SHA-256 封印，只增不改 |

class 封闭集（六种，不可自造）：`feature`、`bug-fix`、`simplification`、`architecture`、`process`、`testing`。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 门禁：以退出码为准：```sh
node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-tree.ts       # 目录/分类/文件名/相对链接
node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts     # 头部/必备小节/备选方案/禁提案标题
node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts  # 归档封印只增不改
```

这些门禁**已被故障注入证明会真的变红**（见下）。插件把门禁能力交给模型，但**强制仍应放在宿主仓库的 CI**：

```yaml

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · .github/workflows/verify-notes.yml（模板见 skills/agent-notes/templates/verify-notes.yml）：- run: node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-*.ts
```

> ⚠️ **照抄上面两行会得到一条恒绿门禁。** 三个脚本在**空集合**上都 `exit 0`，只回答
> 「已有笔记合不合规」，不回答「有没有笔记」。要么在自己 CI 里补一步「至少一篇」的前置
> 判断，要么直接用 `tools/verify-notes.mjs`（空树报 `NO_NOTES_TREE`，有测试与故障注入守着）。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 上游合并：内置内容来自上游固定 commit，可主动核对与合并：

```sh
npm run sync:latest                     # 与上游默认分支逐文件比对，判断是否落后
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs --auto      # 查上游 HEAD 并合并到它（CI 用，隐含 --yes）
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs --check    # 只比对钉死的那个 ref，零写入
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs            # 展示逐文件 diff 摘要，需要 --yes 才落盘

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 两条检查的区别（重要）：| 命令 | 回答的问题 | 会变红吗 |
|---|---|---|
| `--check` | 内置副本与**钉住的那个 commit** 是否逐字相同 | **几乎永远绿** —— ref 就是上次同步时的 commit |
| `--latest` | 内置副本与**上游默认分支**是否一致 | 会：落后即退出码 1 |

`--check` 单独用时是一条**恒绿的门禁**：它存在、每次都过、不验证任何东西。
真正该问的是「上游有没有新提交」，那只能拿本地清单去和上游分支逐文件比。
`--latest` 就是干这个的，`.github/workflows/verify.yml` 会在每次 push、
PR 和每日定时任务里跑它。

退出码语义：`0` 一致，`1` 已落后（真红），`2` 无法核对（网络/限流）。
**`2` 也让 job 变红** —— 否则「查不到」会被当成「没问题」。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 两条检查的区别（重要）：**为什么默认钉 commit 而不是 `main`**：jsDelivr 对分支名的**清单缓存**实测会滞后——锚 `@main` 会拿到重构前的旧目录结构，导致路径枚举失败。但它的**文件读取**是准的（已验证同一文件逐字相同），所以 `--latest` 走「按本地清单逐个取文件内容比对」，不依赖远端枚举。

**为什么不用 GitHub API 查 HEAD**：实测未认证请求 60 次/小时就 403（rate limit exceeded），CI 里天天跑必然撞墙。

合并后必须重跑：

```sh
node --test tools/*.test.mjs && node tools/fault-injection.mjs
```

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 项目内副本：只提示，不擅自改（`/agent-notes sync-skill`）：除了插件自带那份，**项目仓库里通常还有一份** `.agents/skills/agent-notes/`
（被项目 git 跟踪，供项目自己的 CI 门禁使用）。插件自更新**只管自己那份**。

为什么不去自动改项目那份：它属于项目仓库的正式内容。插件擅自改写会

- 让用户的 `git status` 突然变脏；
- 让本地与 CI 跑不同版本的校验脚本；
- 往项目仓库里注入意料之外的改动。

所以这里是**检测 + 提示 + 用户确认**：

1. 开关打开时，插件比对项目副本与内置版本；落后就在注入的规范末尾追加一段提示，
   明确要求模型**先问用户**，而不是自己动手；
2. 用户同意后跑 `/agent-notes sync-skill` —— 默认只打印差异（预览），
   加 `--yes` 才真的落盘；
3. 项目里多出来的文件（内置版本没有的）**不会被删除**，那是项目自己的东西。
section: 项目内副本：只提示，不擅自改（`/agent-notes sync-skill`）

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · CI 不用单独同步：项目 CI 的调用链是：

```
ci.yml → npm run verify-notes → tsx .agents/skills/agent-notes/scripts/*.ts
```

`ci.yml` 里只写 `npm run verify-notes`，**不含版本号或文件清单**。所以同步脚本目录
就等于更新了 CI 实际执行的校验逻辑，`ci.yml`、`package.json`、`.github/` 都不用改。

这些脚本**零外部依赖**，只用 `node:` 内置模块，换版本不会引入新 npm 包。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 技能副本会自己更新（异步，不阻塞启动）：`skills/agent-notes` 是 vendored 副本。为了让已安装的插件不必手动同步，插件在
`apply` 时**后台**拉一次本仓库的技能目录（`lib/self-update.js`）：

- **绝不阻塞启动**：`scheduleSkillUpdate()` 是 fire-and-forget，网络再慢也不拖慢
  `apply`。代价是启动那一刻技能可能还是旧的。
- **失败静默**：断网、CDN 不可达、任何文件拉不到 → 整批放弃，**保留现有副本**。
  技能旧一点可以接受，不可用不行。
- **原子写入**：逐文件写 `.tmp` 再 `rename`，中途失败不留半套内容。
- **内容相同不写盘**：避免每次启动都改 mtime、触发无谓的热替换。
- **热替换**：真的写入新内容后调宿主的 `SkillProviderControl.invalidate()`，
  宿主丢弃缓存并通知消费者重新取，模型下次加载即新内容。
section: 技能副本会自己更新（异步，不阻塞启动）
技能副本会自己更新（异步，不阻塞启动）

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 侧边栏（dsh-better-sidebar）：装了 [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/dhicoc/dsh-better-sidebar) 时，看板也会出现在它的
右侧栏里，**同一个开关控制**：笔记规范关着就不出现，打开才出现。

接入方式是该插件公开的客户端服务 `ctx.betterSidebar.registerTab(...)`，不是私有 API：

- **可选依赖**：用 `ctx.inject(['betterSidebar'], …)` 等待，绝不写进插件级 `inject` ——
  写进去的话，没装那个插件时本插件会**整个不加载**；
- **状态分开记账**：两个宿主（内置槽位 / 侧边栏）各存各的注册状态。共用一份会让
  「一个就绪、另一个没就绪」互相覆盖，表现为 tab 时有时无；
- **会话字段两种形状都认**：内置槽位给顶层 `sessionId`，better-sidebar 给
  `scope.sessionId`。只认一种的话，另一个宿主里 iframe 会拼出空 session，
  路由回 409，整块空白。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 版本号：市场、官方插件源、第三方靠**版本号**判断有没有更新 —— 内容变了但版本号不动，
对它们来说等于没更新。所以：

- 自动合并上游后会 `minor` 递增（`0.2.0` → `0.3.0`）并打 `vX.Y.Z` tag；
- 手动发布用 `node tools/bump-version.mjs [patch|minor|major]`；
- 版本号同时是**自更新的快速探针**：插件启动时只读一个 1.8 KB 的
  `package.json` 判断版本变没变，变了才去拉 21 个技能文件。

实测提速：冷启动（拉全部文件）约 2028 ms，热启动（版本未变）约 79 ms，
**25.7 倍**，且热路径不产生任何文件请求。

> 为什么不用 commit SHA 做探针：试过 jsDelivr 的 `resolved` 端点（对本仓库返回
> `version: null`）、jsDelivr 版本列表（新 tag 迟迟不收录）、GitHub API `/tags`
> （未认证 60 次/小时就 403）。三条都不通，只有读 `package.json` 稳。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 上游会自动合并进来（不再需要手动跑）：`.github/workflows/upstream-sync.yml` 每天定时（也可手动触发）执行：

1. `git ls-remote` 查上游分支的真实 HEAD；
2. 与 `tools/upstream-manifest.json` 记录的 `ref` 比较 —— **相同还不够**，
   还会逐文件校验本地内容与摘要是否一致（ref 只记录上次同步的目标，
   本地文件仍可能被改过）；有出入一样走合并；
3. 逐文件拉取并覆盖，更新清单；
4. **跑完 verify / notes:gate / test / fault-injection 才允许提交**；
5. 用 `github-actions[bot]` 身份提交并 push。

所以完整链路是：

```
原始上游 --(GitHub Action，每日)--> 本仓库 --(插件启动时异步)--> 用户机器
```

两段都不再需要人记得。任何一段失败都会让 job 变红，不会静默跳过。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 自检与测试：```sh
npm test                       # 行为测试（真跑子进程、真写文件）
npm run gate:fault-injection   # 证明门禁会红，而不是恒绿
npm run verify                 # 包自检：清单 / patch / 零依赖 / 双语文档与徽标 / vendored 与上游哈希

`fault-injection` 会为每条门禁注入它该拦的故障（非法分类、坏文件名、缺备选方案、`implemented` 残留提案标题、篡改/删除已封印归档……），断言必须非零退出；再清掉故障断言回到零。**任何一条对故障无反应，该脚本自身非零退出**——它自己也引入了一条必然失败的断言验证过会红。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 自检与测试：其中 `hooks:install` 值得单独说一句：它把「该写笔记而没写」这道检查挂到本地 `commit-msg` 上，当场给出反馈。但钩子能被 `git commit --no-verify` 绕过，**CI 那一道才是权威的**——两道都要在。

> `npm run evidence` 与集成测试需要找到 DSH 安装位置。会自动探测 `$DSH_HOME`、`~/.dsh` 及其各 profile 的 `node_modules`；桌面端内置安装等非标准位置请显式指定：
>
> ```sh
> DSH_DIST=/path/to/dsh/lib/bin.js npm run evidence
> ```
>
> 探测不到时 `evidence` **明确失败（退出码 2）**，不假装通过；集成测试则降级为同契约承接器，并在输出里标注实际用的是哪种模式。

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · 设计约束（为什么零 `@deepseek-ai` 依赖）：本插件**不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`**：profile 的 `node_modules` 里 `@deepseek-ai` 只解析到 `cosmokit`/`schemastery`，插件运行时拿不到 DSH 的类型包。因此：

- 工具用**裸对象**注册（DSH 接受原始 `ToolDefinition`，MCP 工具就这么进来）。

谁往 `lib/` 里加了 `@deepseek-ai/*` import，`tools/verify-plugin.mjs` 的自检立刻红。唯一运行时依赖 `mdast-util-from-markdown` 只被 `tools/` 下的校验脚本使用，不参与插件运行时。

Turn "why we changed it this way and what we gave up" into **mechanically checked** decision notes inside a repository, delivered as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · dsh-agent-notes：> The method is distilled from [czm15053/write-notes-like-deepseek](https://github.com/czm15053/write-notes-like-deepseek), which in turn distills the `.agents/notes/` practice of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
> This plugin packages that method as a native DSH plugin: a skill, session switches, real gates, and upstream merging.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · What it solves：Code can express *how the system currently runs*; it cannot express **why it must run that way, and what was given up**. So every new session will:
"optimize away" an awkward-looking block that was deliberately written that way to avoid a deadlock; punch through global structure to satisfy a local need; and re-propose a design already proven to run out of memory three months ago.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · What it solves：This plugin makes the rules **hard to walk around**: same repository as the code, same change, mechanically checked, old decisions sealed with a tamper-evident hash.
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Install：```sh
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · From a local directory (during development)：dsh plugin add --profile <your-profile> /path/to/dsh-agent-notes

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Or from GitHub：> **`plugin add` writes the dependency but does NOT enable the plugin.** Verified
> behavior: it records the package name in `profiles/<profile>/package.json`
> `dependencies`, but leaves `dsh.profile.bundles` untouched — and DSH loadsjsonc
> // $DSH_HOME/profiles/<your-profile>/package.json
> "dsh": {
>   "profile": {
>     "bundles": [
>       "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
>       "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
>       "dsh-agent-notes"        // ← add this line
>     ]
>   }
> }
> ```
>
> Then **restart DSH**. To confirm it actually loaded, `dsh --profile <your-profile> --dump-config`
> should contain `# == dsh-agent-notes` and `- id: agent-notes`. Present in
> dependencies but absent from `bundles` produces **no startup error** while the
> plugin silently does nothing — the easiest step to get wrong.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Usage：```
/agent-notes                 Show switch and note-tree status
/agent-notes on              Enable for this session (persisted across reloads)
/agent-notes on --global     Change the global default (all sessions without an override)
/agent-notes reset           Clear this session's override, returning to the global default

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Off by default：After installing, **both new and existing sessions start with the policy off** —
turn it on when you need it (click the chip, or `/agent-notes on`). Installing the
plugin therefore never silently changes the behavior of sessions you already have.

To enable it everywhere, either:

```
/agent-notes on --global        # change the global default at runtime, persisted
```

or set `enabled: true` in the plugin config (only for the profile that carries it).

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Off by default：A session override wins over the global default: once you turn a session off, later
global changes won't affect it.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Status indicator in the UI：You don't have to type a command to see whether the policy is on for the current
session: a green chip "● Agent notes" sits **left of the composer tool row**, next
to the permission selector ("Full access" / "Workspace write"), and **clicking it
toggles**. It greys out while off.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Status indicator in the UI：It reads the **session projection** (`agentNotes`), so it stays correct across
reloads, reconnects, and session switches. Clicking submits the official slash
command (`/agent-notes on|off`), so it is exactly equivalent to typing it, and
costs zero tokens.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Status indicator in the UI：> Design note: the projection only folds the host's own `command/run` events —
> **this plugin never writes to the session log**. It cannot: it has zero
> `@deepseek-ai` dependencies, so `appendPluginRecord` is unreachable; and the
> fallback `session.append('plugin:…')` was measured to write a crippled record
> (`ignorable=undefined`, unreadable by `pluginRecordOf`) that looks successful
> while polluting the log. Riding the command event sidesteps that entirely.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Which repository the tools act on：**When the session has no working directory they fail loudly** — `passed: false`
with `reason: "NO_SESSION_CWD"` — instead of falling back to the process working
directory. That fallback is deliberately avoided: the DSH process cwd is **DSH's
own installation directory**, which usually also has `.agents/notes` (DSH's own
development notes). Falling back there would really run and really return green —
while testing a completely different repository. That is a fake green, so we
refuse to produce it.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · The target repository need not be a Node project：The gates work on a repository of **any stack**: notes are Markdown, and the
checks look only at directories, filenames, required sections, and seals — never
at the language. Scripts run under the plugin's own `node` (`process.execPath`),
**never by looking up `node` / `npm` on PATH**, so a machine without Node can

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Zero notes is not a pass：The gates can only return green after verifying **at least one note**:

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| `.agents/notes` does not exist | `passed: false`, `reason: NO_NOTES_TREE` |
| Directory exists but has no notes | `passed: false`, `reason: NO_NOTES_YET` |
| Notes exist and all comply | `passed: true`, `noteCount` is the real count |
| Notes exist but violate rules | `passed: false`, `exitCode: 1` plus diagnostics |
section: Zero notes is not a pass

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Zero notes is not a pass：The three underlying verify scripts all `exit 0` on an empty directory and print
`ok: 0 note(s) verified`. That is true in the sense of "the script found no fault",
but empty in the sense of "are my notes compliant" — **nothing verified is not the
same as verified**. The plugin therefore checks before spawning the script, so an
empty set can never be reported as a pass. The return value always carries
`noteCount` so you can tell the two apart.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · What a note looks like：The path *is* the state; there is no index file:

```
.agents/notes/{lifecycle}/{class}/yyyy-mm-dd-topic.md
```

| lifecycle | meaning |
|---|---|
| `proposed/` | A proposal that has not shipped |
| `implemented/` | Shipped, kept current with the code |
| `rejected/` | Deliberately declined; kept only while it prevents a repeat mistake |
| `archived/` | Sealed with a SHA-256 digest, append-only |
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · What a note looks like：The class set is closed (six): `feature`, `bug-fix`, `simplification`, `architecture`, `process`, `testing`.

node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-tree.ts       # layout / class / filename / relative links
node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts     # header / required sections / alternatives / no proposal titles
node skills/agent-notes/scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts  # archive seals are append-only
```

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Upstream merging：Bundled content comes from a pinned upstream commit and can be checked and merged:

```sh
npm run sync:latest                     # per-file compare against the upstream default branch
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs --auto      # resolve upstream HEAD and merge to it (CI; implies --yes)
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs --check    # compare against the pinned ref only, zero writes
node tools/sync-upstream.mjs            # show a per-file diff summary; needs --yes to write

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · The two checks answer different questions：| Command | Question it answers | Can it go red? |
|---|---|---|
| `--check` | Is the bundled copy byte-identical to **the pinned commit**? | **Almost always green** — the ref *is* the last synced commit |
| `--latest` | Does the bundled copy match **the upstream default branch**? | Yes: exit 1 once it lags |
section: The two checks answer different questions

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · The two checks answer different questions：`--check` on its own is an **always-green gate**: it exists, passes every time, and
verifies nothing. The real question is "has upstream published new commits", and the
only way to answer it is to compare the local manifest against the upstream branch
file by file. That is what `--latest` does, and `.github/workflows/verify.yml` runs it
on every push, every PR, and daily on a schedule.
section: The two checks answer different questions

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · The two checks answer different questions：**Why the default ref is a commit rather than `main`**: jsDelivr's **manifest cache**
for branch names lags in practice — anchoring at `@main` returned a pre-refactor
directory layout, so path enumeration failed. Its **file reads** are accurate, though
(verified: the same file under `@main` and under the pinned commit is byte-identical),
so `--latest` compares file contents against the local manifest and never relies on
remote enumeration.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · CI needs no separate sync：The project CI chain is:

```
ci.yml → npm run verify-notes → tsx .agents/skills/agent-notes/scripts/*.ts
```

`ci.yml` only says `npm run verify-notes` — **no version or file list**. So syncing the
script directory updates exactly what CI executes; `ci.yml`, `package.json` and
`.github/` need no changes.

Those scripts have **zero external dependencies** — only `node:` builtins and mutual
imports — so a version bump cannot introduce a new npm package.

section: The bundled copy updates itself (async, never blocks startup)

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · The bundled copy updates itself (async, never blocks startup)：- **Never blocks startup**: `scheduleSkillUpdate()` is fire-and-forget; slow network
  cannot delay `apply`. The tradeoff is that the copy may still be stale for the
  instant right after startup.
- **Fails silently**: offline, CDN unreachable, or any single file missing → the whole
  batch is abandoned and **the existing copy is kept**. A slightly old skill is
  acceptable; an unusable one is not.
- **Atomic writes**: each file goes to `.tmp` then `rename`, so a mid-flight failure
  never leaves half a tree.
- **No rewrite when identical**: avoids touching mtime and firing a pointless hot swap
  on every startup.
- **Hot swap**: after actually writing new content it calls the host's
  `SkillProviderControl.invalidate()`, which drops cached catalogs and notifies
  consumers — the model sees the new text on its next load.
section: The bundled copy updates itself (async, never blocks startup)

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · The bundled copy updates itself (async, never blocks startup)：Why pull from **this** repository rather than the original upstream: this repo merges
from upstream, which adds a human review layer — if upstream breaks a rule, it can be
blocked here. The source constant is `UPDATE_SOURCE`.

To disable it, remove the `scheduleSkillUpdate(...)` call in `lib/index.js` (or gate it
behind a config flag).
section: The bundled copy updates itself (async, never blocks startup)

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Version numbers：Measured: cold start (fetching every file) ~2028 ms, warm start (version unchanged)
~79 ms — **25.7x**, and the warm path issues zero file requests.

> Why not a commit SHA as the probe: jsDelivr's `resolved` endpoint returns
> `version: null` for this repo, its version listing does not pick up new tags promptly,
> and the GitHub API `/tags` endpoint 403s after 60 unauthenticated requests per hour.
> Only reading `package.json` is reliable.

section: Upstream merges in automatically (no more manual runs)

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Upstream merges in automatically (no more manual runs)：So the full chain is:

```
original upstream --(GitHub Action, daily)--> this repo --(async on plugin startup)--> user machines
```

Neither hop needs anyone to remember. If either fails the job goes red — nothing is
skipped silently.

**Why `git ls-remote` instead of the GitHub API**: unauthenticated requests hit 403
after 60/hour, which a daily job would inevitably trip. The git protocol has no such
limit.
section: Upstream merges in automatically (no more manual runs)

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Upstream merges in automatically (no more manual runs)：**Why resolve a commit instead of anchoring the branch name**: jsDelivr's manifest
cache for branch names lags; anchoring a commit yields that commit's real tree.
section: Upstream merges in automatically (no more manual runs)

text:
@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · When does the model see updated rules：`get()` in `lib/skill.js` **reads the disk on every call** — there is no cache. So
after the self-update writes new content and calls `invalidate()`, the host drops its
cached catalog and the model gets the new content on its next skill load — **DSH does

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Self-check and tests：```sh
npm test                       # behavior tests (real subprocesses, real files)
npm run gate:fault-injection   # prove the gates can go red rather than being always-green
npm run verify                 # package self-check: manifest / patch / zero-dep / bilingual docs + badge / vendored-vs-upstream digests
npm run sync:check             # has upstream drifted? bundled copy vs the pinned ref, byte for byte (really goes red)

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Self-check and tests：`fault-injection` injects, for each gate, the exact defect it should catch (illegal class, bad filename, missing alternatives, a proposal title left in `implemented`, a tampered or deleted sealed archive, …), asserts a non-zero exit, then removes the defect and asserts a return to zero. **If any gate fails to react, the script itself exits non-zero** — and I verified that by injecting a deliberately failing assertion into the script.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Self-check and tests：`hooks:install` deserves its own note: it attaches the "this change should carry a decision note" check to your local `commit-msg`, so you get the feedback at commit time. But a hook can be bypassed with `git commit --no-verify`, so **the CI gate is the authoritative one** — you want both.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Self-check and tests：> `npm run evidence` and the integration tests need to locate a DSH installation. They auto-detect `$DSH_HOME`, `~/.dsh`, and each profile's `node_modules`; for non-standard layouts such as a bundled desktop install, point at it explicitly:
>
> ```sh
> DSH_DIST=/path/to/dsh/lib/bin.js npm run evidence
> ```
>
> When detection fails, `evidence` **fails loudly (exit code 2)** rather than pretending to pass; the integration tests degrade to a same-contract harness and state which mode they used in their output.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Design constraint (why zero `@deepseek-ai` dependencies)：This plugin **imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package**: a profile's `node_modules` resolves `@deepseek-ai` only to `cosmokit`/`schemastery`, so a plugin cannot reach the DSH type packages at runtime. Therefore:

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Design constraint (why zero `@deepseek-ai` dependencies)：Any `@deepseek-ai/*` import added under `lib/` turns `tools/verify-plugin.mjs` red. The single runtime dependency, `mdast-util-from-markdown`, is used only by the validation scripts under `tools/`, never on the plugin runtime path.

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Components：| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Assembly; mount/unmount of the session-scoped policy |
| `lib/state.js` | Global default + per-session override, both persisted (atomic writes) |
| `lib/notes.js` | Note-tree discovery, real gate execution, scaffolding |
| `lib/skill.js` | The `agent-notes` skill provider (strips frontmatter) |
| `lib/policy.js` | The injected policy text |
| `lib/commands.js` | The `/agent-notes` command |
| `lib/tools.js` | The `agent_notes_gate` / `agent_notes_status` tools |
| `skills/agent-notes/` | Vendored upstream content (SKILL.md, references, templates, scripts, assets) |
| `tools/` | Upstream merge, self-check, fault injection, tests |

@iuuuuuuuu/agent-notes README · Known limitations：- The **board template references external Google Fonts**, so offline use falls back to system fonts; functionality is unaffected.
- Upstream syncing depends on jsDelivr reachability; when unreachable, `sync` fails loudly rather than skipping silently.
- DSH is in developer preview. Host API changes may require follow-up.
- Session switches persist **by session id**; after a session is deleted its override remains in the state file, and there is currently no GC.
- Host-repository CI wiring is left to you; the plugin does not modify repositories.
